thread:
lina: mock posted — Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (quickstart sample picker)

matt: +1 on curated defaults. main goal: <reduce time to first API call>. want to prioritize 2 entry samples not 8.

sophie: frontend concerns: images in cards cause layout shift. can we use fixed 72x72 thumbnails + object-fit? keyboard nav: arrow keys should move between cards, Enter to select.

ira: accessibility: contrast on the small tag badges is 3.2:1, need >=4.5:1 for body text. add aria-labels for "Run sample" buttons. also modal should trap focus.

lina: noted. thinking about CTA text: "Try sample" vs "Open sample" vs "Launch demo" — short copy helps. current microcopy: "Start with this sample" is too long.

matt: prefer "Try sample" — consistent with quickstarts. include estimation line: "~ 150 tokens" or "est. cost $.002"?

sophie: token estimate feasible but backend needs to return a small metadata field. I'll add a stub in the sample API: {name, description, est_tokens}.

raj: perf: avoid eager loading all sample model files. implement lazy load + prefetch on hover. thumbnails lazy, but predownload model manifest when hovering for >300ms.

ira: also keyboard-only users shouldn't trigger prefetch on focus unless they intend. use 500ms deliberate hover/focus delay.

lina: proposed visual tweaks: increase badge contrast, swap blue outline to 3px solid for keyboard focus (better visible), and add tooltip with alt copy for icons.

matt: can we trim sample list to 4 curated + "see all" link? analytics shows dilution when too many choices.

sophie: implementation note: use CSS grid with max-width so cards reflow; aria-live region to announce selected sample on focus for screen reader.

lina: copy alternatives (vote):
- Try sample
- Open quickstart
- Run this example

ira: vote: "Try sample" (short + clear). Also add aria-describedby pointing to est_tokens text.

raj: will prototype lazy load + hover prefetch. ETA: next sprint.

lina: thanks. I'll update figma and send new frames in ~2 hours :thumbsup:

design-bot: Lina updated Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/updated — frame: "sample-picker-v2"

matt: schedule quick sync tomorrow 10am to sign off.
